description: Compact rules for writing Power Apps canvas YAML that Power Apps Studio accepts with Paste code (and for *.pa.yaml source files and Paste theme): structure, control types and versions, '=' formulas, multi-line formulas, quoting of ': ' and '#', variables, components, themes, common errors and what pasting does not create (data sources, App properties). Each rule cites Microsoft Learn, the official pa.yaml schema or confirmed practice. Read it before generating canvas YAML.
name: yaml_authoring_guide
title: Power Apps YAML authoring guide
